official_inactives.WHY_NOT_CONFIRMED: the list reached us relayed by reporters and an aggregator, not as an official document this system captured. CONFIRMED_INACTIVE is reserved for TIER_OFFICIAL_CAPTURED. The applied status is already in ABSENT_STATUSES, so opportunity is redistributed identically.

availability_semantics.SILENCE_IS_NOT_ACTIVITY: a player not named on the injury report is UNKNOWN_ACTIVE_STATE, not active. Reading silence as activity would activate the slate on no evidence.

WHAT_IS_MODELLED_HERE: nothing. This is a state artifact; every value is read or supplied.
